items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee only responds 'I don't know' to the interviewer's statement about Charlie Creep; no personal interaction or relationship is described by the interviewee.

ctx.x: He's supposed to be the most soulful blues player in the world, you know, oh, yeah. Charlie Crepp. They called him everything, Charlie Cresp, Charlie Creep --
Now where did the Smith's come from, you know, Russell Smith, Joe Smith, where --
